title: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for a paired red proof
description: A versioned JSON file sitting next to a paired red proof test, named <proof-file>.expected-red.json. Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-proofs.mts. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict CORRUPT PROOF. The runner refuses to classify if this file is missing, invalid JSON, or the test list is empty. EDITOR-ONLY VALUE: this schema is decoration for authoring awareness; it has no runtime consumer. Runtime validation of the manifest is performed line-by-line by readExpectedRedManifest() in apps/front/scripts/ci/classify-proof.mts, whose checks deliberately mirror this schema's assertions. There is no JSON-schema validator in the dependency tree, so wiring this file into the runtime would add ajv to the shipped front package for zero behavioral gain. Keep it in sync by hand with readExpectedRedManifest().

testName.description: The exact test() name declared in the proof file. Matched by suffix/equality against vitest's assertionResults[].fullName.

why.description: Human-readable justification for why this test MUST fail. Surfaced in the runner's CORRUPT PROOF output.

_comment: EDITOR-ONLY SCHEMA (r10): no runtime consumer. The .expected-red.json manifest points here for authoring awareness. The authoritative validator is readExpectedRedManifest() in apps/front/scripts/ci/classify-proof.mts, which enforces exactly these assertions (object, non-empty expectedRed array, testName/why non-empty strings). Keep this file in sync with that function by hand.
